135	function nearPicture2HF(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
136	  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return false;
137	  const wi = st.idx(x, y);
138	  if (st.wall[wi] === 7 || st.wall[wi] === 8 || st.wall[wi] === 9) return true;
139	  const pics = new Set([PIC_240, PIC_242, TILE_BY_KEY['v_241_paintings_6x5'] ?? PIC_242]);
140	  for (let i = x - 8; i <= x + 8; i++) {
141	    for (let j = y - 5; j <= y + 5; j++) {
142	      if (st.inBounds(i, j) && st.flags[st.idx(i, j)] && pics.has(st.type[st.idx(i, j)])) return true;
143	    }
144	  }
145	  return false;
146	}

148	/** RandHellPicture（cs:35210）——掷骰 1:1 */
149	function randHellPicture(rng: RNG): [number, number] {
150	  let num = rng.nextInt(4);
151	  if (num === 1) num = rng.nextInt(4);
152	  switch (num) {
153	    case 0: return [PIC_240, [27, 29, 30, 31, 32][rng.nextInt(5)]!];
154	    case 1: return [PIC_242, 14];
155	    case 2: return [PIC_245, [1, 2, 4][rng.nextInt(3)]!];
156	    default: return [PIC_246, [0, 16, 17][rng.nextInt(3)]!];
157	  }
158	}

160	export function runHellFortPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState,
161	  phaseMark?: (name: string) => void): void {
162	  const { w, h } = st;
163	  const hellTop = h - 200;
164	  if (hellTop >= h - 60) return;
165	  // AddHellHouses(cs:32299-32318):for 逐列 i=100..w-100,正常世界只处理中间 50%
166	  // (num..w-num;drunk/remix 秘密种子域反转,不移植)。**只有成功建成才**跳格
167	  // i += Next(30,130)(再 1/10 追加 Next(0,200));找不到落点仅靠 for 自增 i+1
168	  // 扫下一列——旧实现改成 while 无论成败都跳格+耗骰,塔数量级直接错(H1);
169	  // 有效起点域到 w-num(=0.75w),旧 endX-30 截尾同批修正
170	  const num = Math.floor(w * 0.25);
171	  for (let i = 100; i < w - 100; i++) {
172	    if (i < num || i > w - num) continue;
173	    // 找落点(cs:32307-32310):从 h-40 向上跳过 active/液体格,首格空气即塔底锚点。
174	    // 原版无下界(旧实现自制 y>hellTop 下界已删,H4)
175	    let j = h - 40;
176	    while (st.flags[st.idx(i, j)] || st.liquid[st.idx(i, j)] > 0) j--;
177	    if (st.flags[st.idx(i, j + 1)]) {
178	      // 塔体材质(cs:32311-32317):Next(75,77) 掷底再被 Next(5)>0(4/5)覆盖为 75,
179	      // 净 9/10 黑曜石砖——旧实现单掷 0.8 概率骰,概率与耗骰数均偏
180	      let tileType = rng.int(75, 76) === 75 ? OBS_BRICK : HELL_BRICK;
181	      if (rng.nextInt(5) > 0) tileType = OBS_BRICK;
182	      const wallType = tileType === OBS_BRICK ? 14 : 13;
183	      hellFort(st, rng, i, j, tileType, wallType);
184	      i += rng.int(30, 129); // cs:32331:Next(30,130)
185	      if (rng.nextInt(10) === 0) i += rng.int(0, 199); // cs:32332-32335
186	    }
187	  }
188	  phaseMark?.('torch');
189	  // ---- 恶魔火把(cs:32334-32379):200×(w/4200) 个,贴砖放置,±8 内无其他火把 ----
190	  const torchCount = Math.floor(200 * Math.floor(w / 4200));
191	  for (let n = 0; n < torchCount; n++) {
192	    let tries = 0, placed = false;
193	    while (!placed) {
194	      tries++;
195	      const x = rng.int(Math.floor(w * 0.2), Math.floor(w * 0.8) - 1);
196	      const y = rng.int(h - 300, h - 21);
197	      if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) { if (tries > 1000) break; continue; }
198	      const ti = st.idx(x, y);
199	      if (!st.flags[ti] || (st.type[ti] !== OBS_BRICK && st.type[ti] !== HELL_BRICK)) {
200	        if (tries > 1000) break; else continue;
201	      }
202	      let side = 0;
203	      if (st.inBounds(x - 1, y) && st.wall[st.idx(x - 1, y)] > 0) side = -1;
204	      else if (st.inBounds(x + 1, y) && st.wall[st.idx(x + 1, y)] > 0) side = 1;
205	      if (side === 0) { if (tries > 1000) break; else continue; }
206	      if (st.flags[st.idx(x + side, y)] || st.flags[st.idx(x + side, y + 1)]) {
207	        if (tries > 1000) break; else continue;
208	      }
209	      let near = false;
210	      for (let ix = x - 8; ix < x + 8 && !near; ix++) {
211	        for (let iy = y - 8; iy < y + 8; iy++) {
212	          if (st.inBounds(ix, iy) && st.flags[st.idx(ix, iy)] && st.type[st.idx(ix, iy)] === TORCH) { near = true; break; }
213	        }
214	      }
215	      if (near) { if (tries > 1000) break; else continue; }
216	      // cs:59863-59865 PlaceTile case4:只写 frameY=22*style,frameX 不动(=0);
217	      // style=7(恶魔火把)→ frameY=154。旧实现把 style 写进 frameX 属轴写反(H3)
218	      st.setTileSilent(x + side, y, TORCH, 0, 22 * 7);
219	      placed = true;
220	    }
221	  }
222	  phaseMark?.('furn');
223	  // ---- 家具环（cs:32386-32643）：m < 4200000/w 次，拒绝采样墙 13/14 空格 ----
224	  const num9 = 4200000 / w;
225	  for (let m = 0; m < num9; m++) {
226	    let tries = 0;
227	    let fx = rng.int(num, w - num - 1);            // Next(num, w-num)
228	    let fy = rng.int(h - 250, h - 21);             // Next(h-250, h-20)
229	    const bad = () => {
230	      if (!st.inBounds(fx, fy)) return true;
231	      const i = st.idx(fx, fy);
232	      return (st.wall[i] !== 13 && st.wall[i] !== 14) || st.flags[i] !== 0;
233	    };
234	    while (bad()) {
235	      fx = rng.int(num, w - num - 1);
236	      fy = rng.int(h - 250, h - 21);
237	      tries++;
238	      if (tries > 100000) break;
239	    }
240	    if (tries > 100000 || bad()) continue;
241	    for (; !solidTileHF(st, fx, fy) && fy < h - 20; fy++) { /* 落到地板 */ }
242	    fy--;
243	    let lo = fx, hi = fx;
244	    while (!st.flags[st.idx(lo, fy)] && solidTileHF(st, lo, fy + 1)) lo--;
245	    lo++;
246	    for (; !st.flags[st.idx(hi, fy)] && solidTileHF(st, hi, fy + 1); hi++) { }
247	    hi--;
248	    const width = hi - lo;
249	    const cx = (hi + lo) >> 1;
250	    {
251	      const i = st.idx(cx, fy);
252	      if (st.flags[i] || (st.wall[i] !== 13 && st.wall[i] !== 14) || !solidTileHF(st, cx, fy + 1)) continue;
253	    }
254	    // num16 家具 13 选 1（cs:32448-32512）：[半宽, 高]
255	    const pick = rng.nextInt(13);
256	    const size = [[5, 4], [4, 3], [3, 5], [4, 6], [3, 3], [5, 3], [5, 4], [5, 4], [5, 4], [3, 5], [5, 3], [2, 4], [3, 3]][pick]!;
257	    let kind = pick;
258	    for (let a = cx - size[0]; a <= cx + size[0]; a++) {
259	      for (let b = fy - size[1]; b <= fy; b++) {
260	        if (st.inBounds(a, b) && st.flags[st.idx(a, b)]) { kind = -1; break; }
261	      }
262	    }
263	    if (width < size[0] * 1.75) kind = -1;
264	    const chairMirror = (x: number, y: number) => {   // case0/1/4 左椅 frameX+=18（cs:32543-32547）
265	      const i0 = st.idx(x, y), i1 = st.idx(x, y - 1);
266	      if (st.flags[i0]) st.frameX[i0] += 18;
267	      if (st.flags[i1]) st.frameX[i1] += 18;
268	    };
269	    switch (kind) {
270	      case 0: {
271	        placeHF(st, T_TABLE, cx, fy, 13);
272	        const n22 = rng.nextInt(6);
273	        if (n22 < 3) placeOnTableHF(st, T_CANDLE, cx + n22, fy - 2, 25);
274	        if (!st.flags[st.idx(cx, fy)]) break;
275	        if (!st.flags[st.idx(cx - 2, fy)]) {
276	          if (placeHF(st, T_CHAIR, cx - 2, fy, 16)) chairMirror(cx - 2, fy);
277	        }
278	        if (!st.flags[st.idx(cx + 2, fy)]) placeHF(st, T_CHAIR, cx + 2, fy, 16);
279	        break;
280	      }
281	      case 1: {
282	        placeHF(st, T_BENCH_W, cx, fy, 14);
283	        const n21 = rng.nextInt(4);
284	        if (n21 < 2) placeOnTableHF(st, T_CANDLE, cx + n21, fy - 1, 25);
285	        if (!st.flags[st.idx(cx, fy)]) break;
286	        if (rng.nextInt(2) === 0) {
287	          if (!st.flags[st.idx(cx - 1, fy)]) {
288	            if (placeHF(st, T_CHAIR, cx - 1, fy, 16)) chairMirror(cx - 1, fy);
289	          }
290	        } else if (!st.flags[st.idx(cx + 2, fy)]) {
291	          placeHF(st, T_CHAIR, cx + 2, fy, 16);
292	        }
293	        break;
294	      }
295	      case 2: placeHF(st, TILE_BY_KEY['v_105_statue']!, cx, fy, 49); break;
296	      case 3: placeHF(st, T_BOOKCASE, cx, fy, 4); break;
297	      case 4:
298	        if (rng.nextInt(2) === 0) {
299	          if (placeHF(st, T_CHAIR, cx, fy, 16)) chairMirror(cx, fy);
300	        } else placeHF(st, T_CHAIR, cx, fy, 16);
301	        break;
302	      case 5:
303	        if (rng.nextInt(2) === 0) place4x2HF(st, T_BED, cx, fy, 8);
304	        else place4x2HF(st, T_BED, cx, fy, 8);   // direction=-1 仅镜像帧（备案）
305	        break;
306	      case 6: placeHF(st, T_PIANO, cx, fy, 15); break;
307	      case 7: placeHF(st, T_DRESSER, cx, fy, 9); break;
308	      case 8: placeHF(st, T_BENCH, cx, fy, 10); break;
309	      case 9: placeHF(st, T_CLOCK, cx, fy, 17); break;
310	      case 10:
311	        if (rng.nextInt(2) === 0) place4x2HF(st, T_BATHTUB, cx, fy, 25);
312	        else place4x2HF(st, T_BATHTUB, cx, fy, 25);
313	        break;
314	      case 11: placeHF(st, T_LAMP, cx, fy, 23); break;
315	      case 12: placeHF(st, T_CANDELABRA, cx, fy, 25); break;
316	    }
317	  }
318	  phaseMark?.('pic');
319	  // ---- 挂画环（cs:32645-32744）：num23 < 420000/w 次 ----
320	  const num9b = 420000 / w;
321	  for (let n23 = 0; n23 < num9b; n23++) {
322	    let tries = 0;
323	    let px = rng.int(num, w - num - 1), py = rng.int(h - 250, h - 21);
324	    const bad = () => {
325	      if (!st.inBounds(px, py)) return true;
326	      const i = st.idx(px, py);
327	      return (st.wall[i] !== 13 && st.wall[i] !== 14) || st.flags[i] !== 0;
328	    };
329	    while (bad()) {
330	      px = rng.int(num, w - num - 1);
331	      py = rng.int(h - 250, h - 21);
332	      tries++;
333	      if (tries > 100000) break;
334	    }
335	    if (tries > 100000) continue;
336	    let x0 = px, x1 = px, y0 = py, y1 = py;
337	    for (let it = 0; it < 2; it++) {
338	      x0 = px; x1 = px;
339	      const wallOK = (x: number, y: number) => st.inBounds(x, y)
340	        && (st.wall[st.idx(x, y)] === 13 || st.wall[st.idx(x, y)] === 14);
341	      while (!st.flags[st.idx(x0, py)] && wallOK(x0, py) && x0 > 10) x0--;
342	      x0++;
343	      for (; !st.flags[st.idx(x1, py)] && wallOK(x1, py) && x1 < st.w - 10; x1++) { }
344	      x1--;
345	      px = (x0 + x1) >> 1;
346	      y0 = py; y1 = py;
347	      while (st.inBounds(px, y0) && !st.flags[st.idx(px, y0)] && wallOK(px, y0)) y0--;
348	      y0++;
349	      for (; st.inBounds(px, y1) && !st.flags[st.idx(px, y1)] && wallOK(px, y1); y1++) { }
350	      y1--;
351	      py = (y0 + y1) >> 1;
352	    }
353	    x0 = px; x1 = px;
354	    const row3Clear = (x: number, y: number) => st.inBounds(x, y)
355	      && !st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] && (!st.inBounds(x, y - 1) || !st.flags[st.idx(x, y - 1)])
356	      && (!st.inBounds(x, y + 1) || !st.flags[st.idx(x, y + 1)]);
357	    while (row3Clear(x0, py) && x0 > 10) x0--;
358	    x0++;
359	    for (; row3Clear(x1, py) && x1 < st.w - 10; x1++) { }
360	    x1--;
361	    y0 = py; y1 = py;
362	    const col3Clear = (x: number, y: number) => st.inBounds(x, y)
363	      && !st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] && (!st.inBounds(x - 1, y) || !st.flags[st.idx(x - 1, y)])
364	      && (!st.inBounds(x + 1, y) || !st.flags[st.idx(x + 1, y)]);
365	    while (col3Clear(px, y0)) y0--;   // 原版无上界（y 可负→inBounds 拦）
366	    y0++;
367	    for (; col3Clear(px, y1); y1++) { }
368	    y1--;
369	    px = (x0 + x1) >> 1;
370	    py = (y0 + y1) >> 1;
371	    if (x1 - x0 <= 7 || y1 - y0 <= 5) continue;
372	    let ok = 0;
373	    if (nearPicture2HF(st, px, py)) ok = -1;
374	    if (ok === 0) {
375	      const [tile, style] = randHellPicture(rng);
376	      if (!nearPictureHF(st, px, py)) placeHF(st, tile, px, py, style, 'top', false);
377	    }
378	  }
379	  phaseMark?.('banner');
380	  // ---- 旗帜/吊灯环（cs:32746-32843）：array[3] 互异 style + num35 < 420000/w ----
381	  const styles = [rng.nextIntRange(16, 22), 0, 0];
382	  while (styles[1] === styles[0]) styles[1] = rng.nextIntRange(16, 22);
383	  while (styles[2] === styles[0] || styles[2] === styles[1]) styles[2] = rng.nextIntRange(16, 22);
384	  for (let n35 = 0; n35 < num9b; n35++) {
385	    let tries = 0;
386	    let bx = num, by = h - 250;
387	    do {
388	      bx = rng.int(num, w - num - 1);
389	      by = rng.int(h - 250, h - 21);
390	      tries++;
391	    } while (tries <= 100000 && (() => {
392	      if (!st.inBounds(bx, by)) return true;
393	      const i = st.idx(bx, by);
394	      return (st.wall[i] !== 13 && st.wall[i] !== 14) || st.flags[i] !== 0;
395	    })());
396	    if (tries > 100000) continue;
397	    while (!solidTileHF(st, bx, by) && by > 10) by--;
398	    by++;
399	    {
400	      const i = st.idx(bx, by);
401	      if (st.wall[i] !== 13 && st.wall[i] !== 14) continue;
402	    }
403	    let pick2 = rng.nextInt(3);
404	    const sz = pick2 === 1 ? [3, 3] : pick2 === 2 ? [1, 2] : [1, 3];
405	    // ★原版此处内层读锚点格 (num37,num38) 而非 (num42,num43)（cs:32807 反编译事实,
406	    //   等效为对锚点格反复判活）——1:1 保留
407	    {
408	      const i = st.idx(bx, by);
409	      const anchorActive = st.flags[i] !== 0;
410	      for (let a = bx - 1; a <= bx + sz[0]; a++) {
411	        for (let b = by; b <= by + sz[1]; b++) {
412	          if (anchorActive) {
413	            const t = st.type[i];
414	            if (t === 10 || t === 11 || t === 34 || t === 42 || t === 91) pick2 = -1;
415	          } else if (anchorActive) pick2 = -1;
416	        }
417	      }
418	    }
419	    switch (pick2) {
420	      case 0: placeHF(st, T_BANNER, bx, by, styles[rng.nextInt(3)]!, 'top', false); break;
421	      case 1: placeHF(st, T_CHANDELIER, bx, by, 32, 'top', false); break;
422	      case 2: placeHF(st, T_LANTERN, bx, by, 32, 'top', false); break;
423	    }
424	  }
425	  void gs;
426	}

428	function hellFort(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, i: number, j: number, tileType: number, wallType: number): void {
429	  const { w, h } = st;
430	  const hellTop = h - 200;
431	  // ---- 列左右界(cs L16563-16572):中央 ±4-9,其余依次外扩 8-19 ----
432	  const colL = new Array<number>(5), colR = new Array<number>(5);
433	  colL[2] = i - rng.int(4, 9);
434	  colR[2] = i + rng.int(4, 9);
435	  colL[3] = colR[2]; colR[3] = colL[3] + rng.int(8, 19);
436	  colL[4] = colR[3]; colR[4] = colL[4] + rng.int(8, 19);
437	  colR[1] = colL[2]; colL[1] = colR[1] - rng.int(8, 19);
438	  colR[0] = colL[1]; colL[0] = colR[0] - rng.int(8, 19);
439	  // ---- 行上下界(cs L16575-16586):层高 6-11,行 3 锚定 j ----
440	  const rowT = new Array<number>(10), rowB = new Array<number>(10);
441	  rowT[3] = j - rng.int(6, 11); rowB[3] = j;
442	  for (let r = 4; r < 10; r++) { rowT[r] = rowB[r - 1]; rowB[r] = rowT[r] + rng.int(6, 11); }
443	  for (let r = 2; r >= 0; r--) { rowB[r] = rowT[r + 1]; rowT[r] = rowB[r] - rng.int(6, 11); }
444	  // ---- 占用网格(cs L16587-16640):2 轮各两个 1/3 翼 ----
445	  const occ: boolean[][] = Array.from({ length: 5 }, () => new Array(10).fill(false));
446	  let hasLWing = false, hasRWing = false;
447	  let spanLo = 3, spanHi = 3;
448	  for (let round = 0; round < 2; round++) {
449	    if (rng.int(0, 2) === 0) {
450	      hasLWing = true;
451	      let r = rng.int(0, 9);
452	      if (r < spanLo) spanLo = r;
453	      if (r > spanHi) spanHi = r;
454	      let wingCol = 1;
455	      if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) { occ[0][r] = true; occ[1][r] = true; wingCol = 0; }
456	      else occ[1][r] = true;
457	      let dir = rng.int(0, 1); if (dir === 0) dir = -1;
458	      for (let steps = rng.int(0, 9); steps > 0 && r >= 0 && r < 10; r += dir) occ[wingCol][r] = true;
459	    }
460	    if (rng.int(0, 2) === 0) {
461	      hasRWing = true;
462	      let r = rng.int(0, 9);
463	      if (r < spanLo) spanLo = r;
464	      if (r > spanHi) spanHi = r;
465	      let wingCol = 3;
466	      if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) { occ[3][r] = true; occ[4][r] = true; wingCol = 4; }
467	      else occ[3][r] = true;
468	      let dir = rng.int(0, 1); if (dir === 0) dir = -1;
469	      for (let steps = rng.int(0, 9); steps > 0 && r >= 0 && r < 10; r += dir) occ[wingCol][r] = true;
470	    }
471	  }
472	  // ---- 列合法性(cs L16641-16662):出界或地狱层已有墙 → 整列弃用 ----
473	  for (let c = 0; c < 5; c++) {
474	    let bad = false;
475	    if (colL[c] < 10 || colL[c] > w - 10) bad = true;
476	    else {
477	      for (let y = hellTop; y < h; y++) {
478	        if (st.inBounds(colL[c], y) && st.wall[st.idx(colL[c], y)] > 0) { bad = true; break; }
479	      }
480	    }
481	    if (bad) for (let r = 0; r < 10; r++) occ[c][r] = false;
482	  }
483	  // ---- 中央列跨度(cs L16663-16682)----
484	  let n4 = rng.int(0, 9); if (n4 < spanLo) spanLo = n4;
485	  let n5 = rng.int(0, 9); if (n5 > spanHi) spanHi = n5;
486	  if (!hasLWing && !hasRWing) {
487	    let guard = 0;
488	    while (spanHi - spanLo < 5 && guard++ < 1000) {
489	      const a = rng.int(0, 9); if (a < spanLo) spanLo = a;
490	      const b = rng.int(0, 9); if (b > spanHi) spanHi = b;
491	    }
492	  }
493	  for (let r = spanLo; r <= spanHi; r++) occ[2][r] = true;
494	  // ---- 越界单元清除(cs L16683-16690)----
495	  for (let c = 0; c < 5; c++) {
496	    for (let r = 0; r < 10; r++) {
497	      if (occ[c][r] && (rowT[r] < hellTop || rowB[r] > h - 20)) occ[c][r] = false;
498	    }
499	  }
500	  // ---- 绘制(cs L16691-16718):四边实心砖,内部墙+清空 ----

118	## 方法与口径
119	
120	- **快照采集**：钩 `RNG.prototype.reseed`。每 pass 头重播（RunPass 语义，WorldGenerator.cs:497）
121	  即「上一 pass 末态」：槽头重播（stack 帧 func=`generateWorld`）比对 `dump[该槽末 pass]`
122	  （槽名由 onWorldPartial 回溯——**按槽名而非位置映射，管线重排免疫**）；槽内 `▶标签` 重播
123	  比对 `dump[pass-1]`；紧跟槽头/同标签的冗余重播跳过。本轮 118 事件 104 比对，as-run 槽序
124	  与静态枚举零漂移（事件日志含 stack 帧在 JSON `eventLog`）。
125	- **归一**：JS `type[]` 经 `TILE_DEFS[].vanilla.sheet` 归一到原版 tile id（EMPTY=0→0；
126	  无 sheet 的 active id 记 0x7777 并单独计数，本轮 0 处）；`wall[]` 本仓已是原版 wld 墙 id
127	  直比；`liquid[]` 0-255 直比；act = `flags&1`。
128	- **typ 是 RAW**（保留 inactive 格残留 type，与 dump 同口径）。故 typ 差异拆两列：
129	  **实差**（双方 active 但类型不同，或一方 active）与 **ghost**（双方 inactive、残留 type 不同
130	  ——原版保留残留、我们多处清 0 的既有 parity 差，非内容差异）。
131	- **new 列** = 上一比对边界还一致、本边界变不一致的格数 ≈ 该 pass 产出的新增分歧
132	  （上限口径：见「级联告警」）。

442	
443	原版击杀带**类型门**（WorldGen.cs:39146-39155 / 39193-39202）：
444	`if (Main.tile[x, num].type == Main.tile[x, j].type) KillTile(x, num);`——仅杀
445	type==被查格（165）的格。JS 曾 `if (flag) { kill(num); kill(num+1); }` 无条件双杀。
446	
447	现场（slab78 列 i=-1，入口 (dx-1,dy0/1) 有一对大理石地面钟乳石 fx=504 fy=36/54）：
448	j=1 放置大理石覆写 fy54 底格 → 邻查 fy36 顶格 → `type[b]!==type[a]` → flag3 →
449	**原版只杀 165 顶格；JS 把刚放的板格大理石一并抹掉** → 后续格 SmoothSlope mask

451	板上 165 被 ResetToType 覆写是 PlaceSlab 常态，故每 biome 都有数处此型分叉。

function placeTileDoorHF(st, rng, x, j): boolean {
  // PlaceTile(x, j, 10, forced:false) 1:1（cs:59868-59906 分支 A/B + PlaceDoor cs:31938）
  const inact = (a, b) => { if (!st.inBounds(a,b)) return false; return st.flags[st.idx(a,b)] === 0; };
  const actSolid = (a, b) => { if (!st.inBounds(a,b)) return false; const i = st.idx(a,b); if (!st.flags[i]) return false; const d = TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]]; return !!d && !!d.solid; };
  if (inact(x, j-1) && inact(x, j-2) && actSolid(x, j-3)) {
    placeDoorHF(st, rng, x, j-1);
    return true;
  }
  if (st.flags[st.idx(x, j+1)] !== 0 || st.flags[st.idx(x, j+2)] !== 0 || !actSolid(x, j+3)) return false;
  placeDoorHF(st, rng, x, j+1);
  return true;
}

function placeDoorHF(st, rng, x, j): boolean {

2. **右外门原版 bug**：cs:33218 界外判据用列号 `num37<20`（恒真）而非 x → 校验循环首个占用行即 break，**正常世界右外门从不触发**（dump 右墙列全砖实证）；旧实现改成 x 判据致右门误发。
3. **家具/挂画/旗灯放置 Place\* 家族 1:1**（16 helper 替代 placeHF 近似）：工作台=Place2x1(2×1)、落地钟=Place2xX(高5)、床/浴缸 direction 镜像帧基 72、挂画 240/242/245/246 各自锚点几何与帧距、烛台 tileTable 底检等。
4. **旗灯环锚点判活**「内列任意活性类型拒」分支（cs:32808-32834）——旧版只判类型集致灯笼覆写真火把。
5. **styles[3] 三元素先掷再判重**（cs:32744-57）——旧版 0 占位少掷。
